hero.title: Welcome to dhbwCloud Self-Service
hero.intro: The DHBW's cloud, workspaces, language models and DNS.

projects.title: Cloud
projects.lead: Cloud projects with virtual machines, networks and storage in OpenStack.
projects.a: Small requests are often approved instantly
projects.b: Add others to work on it together
projects.c: Runs until the end date you choose, and can be extended

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.lead: JupyterLab and VS Code in the browser, on CPU or GPU — with the project's environment.
workspaces.a: Notebook on the CPU, a GPU kernel only while it computes
workspaces.b: Files stay with the project, with a shared folder for all members
workspaces.c: Your own environment from a container image or a Git repository

dns.title: DNS names & certificates
dns.lead: Your own hostnames for your services, with TLS certificates.
dns.a: Activate your personal zone, e.g. myapp.you.users.dhbw.site
dns.b: Records by hand or automated with ddclient, nsupdate or external-dns
dns.c: Ready-made cert-manager manifests in the "TLS Certificates" tab

llm.title: Language models
llm.lead: Private language models on DHBW hardware — in the browser and via API.
llm.a: The DHBW chat right in the browser
llm.b: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for VS Code and your own programs
llm.c: Prompts are neither logged nor passed on

acme: Certificates for the names handed out here come <1>only from the DHBW ACME server</1> (<2>{{host}}</2>); public CAs such as Let's Encrypt do not work for them. The server is free, has no rate limits and also issues certificates for services reachable only inside the DHBW network.
